scope: Synthetic one-asset long/flat SMA trial; 4 predeclared lookbacks. Expanding training windows, 4 non-overlapping test windows, 5 bps per unit turnover and 10 bps cost stress. Separate windows start and end flat, including the buy-and-hold comparator. Costs approximate daily returns. No market-specific taxes, dividends, universe selection, realistic fills, statistical-significance test or NSE/BSE integration. This is not evidence of alpha.
